technology.h2: Commitments you can verify on your first visit.
technology.sub: We don't ask for blind trust. Every point on this list is something you can verify from day one — without waiting for results.
technology.std1Title: The initial consultation is free and commitment-free.
technology.std1Body: Before discussing treatments, we listen. The first visit is a clinical conversation — no quotes, no service list. Just diagnosis.
technology.std2Title: A doctor present for every procedure.
technology.std2Body: No session is delegated. The same specialist who makes the diagnosis performs the treatment and signs the follow-up. No intermediaries between you and your doctor.
technology.std3Title: We do less when less is enough.
technology.std3Body: We don't optimise for more sessions. If the expected result can be achieved with less intervention, that's what we recommend — and we document it.
technology.std4Title: Available 24/7 for questions before and after.
technology.std4Body: Our AI agent answers questions about treatments, recovery and follow-up at any time. It doesn't replace the doctor — it complements them.
technology.std5Title: Your clinical history stays within Estetia.
technology.std5Body: We don't share medical information with third parties, build advertising profiles or use your data for anything other than your direct care. No fine print.
technology.std6Title: Treatment doesn't end when you leave the clinic.
technology.std6Body: Every protocol includes planned reviews. We measure progress, adjust when needed and document results. The process is continuous, not one-off.

faq.h2: Clear answers to help you decide with confidence.
faq.sub: We explain the essentials without unnecessary jargon. If you need deeper clinical detail, the medical team expands on every point during the consultation.
faq.cat1q1: How do I know which treatment is right for me?
faq.cat1a1: We start with a diagnostic consultation to review objectives, indications and recovery times. From there, a personalised and scalable plan is proposed.
faq.cat1a2: It depends on the protocol. Some treatments show visible improvement in the first session, while others progressively optimise texture and firmness over weeks or months.
faq.cat1q3: How many sessions do I need to see real changes?
faq.cat1a3: Most protocols work in cycles of 3 to 6 sessions. At the initial consultation we explain what to expect at each phase and when it's reasonable to evaluate results.
faq.cat2q1: What safety guarantees does Estetia offer?
faq.cat2a1: We work with prior medical assessment, clear contraindications and post-treatment follow-up. The goal is to minimise risks and preserve natural results.
faq.cat2a2: Yes, and they vary by treatment. During the consultation we review clinical history, medication and skin conditions to rule out unsuitable protocols.
faq.cat2q3: What happens if the result is not as expected?
faq.cat2a3: We review the case, adjust the protocol and document the causes. No result is abandoned without analysis — follow-up is part of the service from day one.
faq.cat3q1: How much time should I set aside for a first visit?
faq.cat3a1: We recommend between 45 and 60 minutes for diagnosis, planning and explanation of therapeutic alternatives with recovery times.
faq.cat3q2: Can I combine several treatments in the same phase?
faq.cat3a2: Yes, when medical criteria allow. The combined strategy is designed to add benefits without compromising safety or the natural appearance of results.
faq.cat3a3: Yes. The first visit is a no-commitment diagnosis. If you decide to proceed, the consultation cost is deducted from the first treatment.
faq.cat4q1: Can the agent give me a medical diagnosis?
faq.cat4a1: No. The agent guides, informs and helps prepare the consultation, but does not replace a doctor's clinical assessment. Any treatment recommendation requires an in-person visit.
faq.cat4q2: What kind of questions can I ask it?
faq.cat4a2: Questions about treatments, recovery times, indicative prices, availability and post-session queries. Available 24/7 and responds in clear language, without jargon.
faq.cat4q3: Is it safe to share personal information with the assistant?
faq.cat4a3: Yes. Conversations are protected under European GDPR regulations. No identifying data is stored or shared with third parties.

ia.heroP: At Estetia we use AI where it demonstrably works: with rigour, transparency and clear limits. Exactly as we use any other advanced technology.
ia.cap1Desc: Real-time availability. Schedule your visit in seconds, no forms and no office hours needed.
ia.cap2Desc: Prices, recovery, results — trained on Estetia's real protocols, not generic information.
ia.cap3Desc: Not sure what to choose? Differences, indications and expected outcomes to guide your decision.
ia.cap4Desc: Interrupt, change topic, rephrase. It understands context and responds with genuine fluency.
ia.cap5Desc: When a query requires medical judgement, it detects this and connects you with the right professional.
ia.cap6Desc: It does not issue diagnoses or clinical recommendations. All medical decisions are exclusively the responsibility of Estetia's team.
ia.pillar1Copy: Built on ElevenLabs, the world reference in AI voice synthesis. No generic solutions, no shortcuts.
ia.pillar2Copy: Not an off-the-shelf AI. It knows our protocols, treatments and clinical criteria. It knows when it can't help.
ia.pillar3Copy: AI handles operations with precision. The team dedicates its expertise to what no machine can do: treating you as a unique individual.
ia.compliance1Content: All personal data handled under GDPR requirements. Rights of access, rectification and deletion guaranteed. We never share data with third parties without explicit consent.
ia.compliance2Content: Agent classified as limited risk: conversational assistant for appointments and non-clinical queries. We meet the active transparency obligation — users always know they are interacting with AI.
ia.compliance3Content: All communication with the agent uses TLS encryption. Data protected both in transit and at rest.
ia.compliance4Content: Conversations are not used to retrain AI models, whether our own or third parties'. No third party accesses identifying data without explicit consent.
ia.compliance5Content: Platform with SOC2 certification and GDPR compliance, operating under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework that legally governs data transfers between Europe and the USA.
ia.agentActiveP: Our voice assistant is available right now to answer questions, compare treatments or find the ideal time for your appointment — no forms, no waiting.
ia.positionP1: When we decide what technology to use at Estetia, we ask one question: does it improve the outcome for the patient? If the answer is yes, we integrate it. If not, we don’t.
ia.positionP2: We have done this with the most advanced aesthetic devices on the market. And we do the same with artificial intelligence. Not because it’s a trend — but because in a specific part of our operation, AI is objectively better than any alternative.
ia.positionP3: There are tasks where AI doesn’t make fatigue-related errors, has no schedule and can handle multiple cases in parallel. That part is theirs.
ia.positionP4Strong: That part is always the team’s.
ia.positionP4: And there are tasks where no machine can replace clinical judgement, empathy or accumulated experience. That part is always the team’s.
ia.positionP5: What we have built is not a customer service chatbot. It is a clinical intelligence system that allows our doctors to be fully available for the only thing that matters: treating you as a unique case.
ia.positionQuote:
"AI gives us presence where we could not reach before.
The team provides judgement where no AI can."
ia.capP: Specifically trained on Estetia’s protocols, treatments and clinical criteria. It doesn’t respond generically — it responds with clinical precision.
ia.complianceP: Advanced technology and data protection are not opposites. We meet the most demanding European standards — not as an obligation, but as part of doing it right.
ia.metaDesc: Technology in the service of what cannot be automated. Our approach to AI, voice assistant capabilities, and regulatory compliance.

hydrafacialMd.heroP: The most advanced deep-cleansing protocol on the market. Exfoliates, extracts and saturates the skin with actives in a single session.
hydrafacialMd.benefit1Desc: Removes impurities, dead cells and excess sebum at depth.
hydrafacialMd.benefit2Desc: Infusion of hyaluronic acid, antioxidants and peptides into the dermis.
hydrafacialMd.benefit3Desc: Visible improvement in texture and tone from the very first session.
hydrafacialMd.benefit4Desc: Non-invasive protocol. Resume your normal activities immediately.
hydrafacialMd.benefit5Desc: Adapts to all skin types and can be combined with other treatments.
hydrafacialMd.benefit6Desc: Gentle technology that respects the skin barrier even in reactive skin.
hydrafacialMd.step1Desc: Removal of dead cells with diamond tip and gentle cleansing solution.
hydrafacialMd.step2Desc: Application of glycolic and salicylic acid to loosen pores and prepare skin.
hydrafacialMd.step3Desc: Painless suction with Vortex spiral that extracts impurities without damaging tissue.
hydrafacialMd.step4Desc: Saturation with hyaluronic acid, vitamin C and biostimulating peptides.
hydrafacialMd.ctaH2Line2: we evaluate your skin for HydraFacial

radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.heroP: Controlled thermal energy for deep collagen remodelling without surgery. Firmness, lifting and rejuvenation in a precision protocol.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.benefit1Desc: Visible skin tightening without scalpel or hospital stay.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.benefit2Desc: Stimulates type I and III collagen synthesis in the deep dermis.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.benefit3Desc: Reduction of pores, acne scars and superficial irregularities.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.benefit4Desc: Results improve for 3–6 months after the full cycle.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.benefit5Desc: Enhances results of fillers, botulinum toxin and biostimulators.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.benefit6Desc: No incisions or stitches. The skin regenerates from within.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.mec1Desc: Temperature of 42–45°C in mid and deep dermis without damaging epidermis.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.mec3Desc: Activated fibroblasts synthesise new collagen over weeks.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.mec4Desc: The dermis reorganises and thickens over the following 3–6 months.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.step1Desc: Makeup removal and deep cleansing of the area to be treated.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.step2Desc: Marking of priority areas based on the prior diagnosis.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.step3Desc: Specific gel to optimise thermal energy transmission.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.step4Desc: Systematic zone-by-zone application with real-time thermal control.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.step5Desc: Continuous verification to maintain optimal therapeutic temperature.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.timeline1Desc: Initial improvement in texture and surface firmness.
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.indication6: Dull skin with loss of radiance
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.contra1: Metal implants in the treatment area
radiofrecuenciaFacialFraccionada.contra4: Active infection or open wounds in the area

criolipolis.heroP: Definitive elimination of localised fat through controlled cooling. No surgery, no anaesthesia, no recovery time.
criolipolis.mech1Desc: The applicator suctions adipose tissue between two cooling plates.
criolipolis.mech2Desc: Temperature drops gradually to the lipid crystallisation point.
criolipolis.mech3Desc: Adipocytes crystallise and the body identifies them as damaged cells.
criolipolis.mech4Desc: The lymphatic system eliminates dead adipocytes over 8–12 weeks.
criolipolis.proto1Desc: Zone evaluation, tissue pinching and selection of appropriate applicator.
criolipolis.proto2Desc: Precise delimitation of the area to be treated to optimise coverage.
criolipolis.proto3Desc: Gel membrane to protect skin from direct contact with cold plates.
criolipolis.proto4Desc: Controlled suction of adipose tissue with CoolSculpting applicator.
criolipolis.proto5Desc: 35–60 minutes of constant cooling at therapeutic temperature.
criolipolis.proto6Desc: 2 minutes of intense massage to break fat crystals and accelerate elimination.
criolipolis.proto7Desc: Evaluation of treated area and application of soothing cream.
criolipolis.proto8Desc: Definition of additional sessions if the case requires it.
criolipolis.timeline1Desc: Start of inflammatory process. Possible mild discomfort.
criolipolis.timeline3Desc: Appreciable partial result. Clothes fit better.
criolipolis.timeline4Desc: Final result. 20–25% reduction in adipose volume.
criolipolis.indication1: Localised fat resistant to diet and exercise
criolipolis.indication3: Pinchable area with at least 2.5 cm of tissue
criolipolis.indication7: Alternative to surgery in non-surgical risk profiles
criolipolis.contra3: Neuropathy in the area to be treated
criolipolis.contra4: Hernia or recent scar in the area

inductoresColageno.heroP: Sculptra and Radiesse. Two next-generation biostimulators to restore volume, structure and skin quality from within.
inductoresColageno.sculptraDesc: Poly-L-lactic acid. Progressive stimulation. Ideal for diffuse facial volume loss and highly lipoatrophic faces.
inductoresColageno.radiessDesc: Calcium hydroxyapatite. Immediate volumising effect + biostimulation. Ideal for hands, décolleté and cheeks.
inductoresColageno.massageNotice: Mandatory 5-5-5 massage protocol after each Sculptra session.
inductoresColageno.benefit1Desc: Fills facial fat loss without an artificial appearance.
inductoresColageno.benefit2Desc: Stimulates sustained production of type I and III collagen.
inductoresColageno.benefit3Desc: Improvement develops gradually over 3–6 months post-treatment.
inductoresColageno.benefit4Desc: Sculptra lasts up to 3 years. Radiesse up to 18 months.
inductoresColageno.benefit5Desc: No 'full face' appearance. The result is an improved version of your own volume.
inductoresColageno.benefit6Desc: Resorbable materials. The body metabolises them naturally.
inductoresColageno.benefit7Desc: Beyond volume, improves texture, radiance and firmness.
inductoresColageno.benefit8Desc: Enhances results of botulinum toxin and hyaluronic acid fillers.

inductoresColageno.step2Desc: Zone marking and planning of number of sessions.
inductoresColageno.step3Desc: Cleansing and topical anaesthesia application if required.
inductoresColageno.step4Desc: Blunt cannula technique for greater safety and homogeneous distribution.
inductoresColageno.step5Desc: Immediate massage to homogenise product and prevent nodules.
inductoresColageno.step6Desc: Verification of immediate result and care instructions.
inductoresColageno.step7Desc: For Sculptra: 5 minutes, 5 times a day, 5 days post-session.

inductoresColageno.indication3: Sunken cheeks and poorly defined cheekbones

prpCapilar.benefit9Desc: We assess the scalp before and throughout the treatment.
prpCapilar.factor2Desc: Vascular endothelial growth factor. Angiogenesis and vascularisation.
prpCapilar.factor4Desc: Insulin-like growth factor 1. Follicular cycle activation.
prpCapilar.procStep1Desc: Extraction of 20–30 ml of venous blood from the patient.
prpCapilar.procStep2Desc: Separation of blood components via centrifugal force.
prpCapilar.procStep3Desc: Plasma activation with calcium chloride to release growth factors.
prpCapilar.procStep4Desc: Microinjection into the scalp with a 30G needle.
prpCapilar.step1Desc: Scalp evaluation with dermoscope to map zones.
prpCapilar.step2Desc: Venous sample collection and PRP kit preparation.
prpCapilar.step3Desc: 8–12 minute process to separate platelet-rich plasma.
prpCapilar.step4Desc: Activator addition to maximise growth factor release.
prpCapilar.step5Desc: Anaesthetic cream on scalp for 30 minutes.
prpCapilar.step6Desc: Intradermal injections every 1 cm in diagnosed zones.
prpCapilar.step7Desc: Gentle massage to distribute plasma across the treated area.
prpCapilar.step8Desc: Do not wash hair for 24h. Avoid direct sun for 48h.
prpCapilar.step9Desc: Trichoscopic evaluation of response and session planning.
prpCapilar.milestone3Desc: Improvement in density and hair shaft thickness.

microneedling.heroP: Controlled collagen induction via dermal microchannels combined with autologous growth factors. Texture, pores and scars transformed.
microneedling.mod1Desc: With vitamin C serum, hyaluronic acid or retinol. Indicated for maintenance and texture improvement.
microneedling.mod2Desc: With autologous platelet-rich plasma. Maximum biostimulation. Indicated for scars, alopecia and advanced ageing.
microneedling.step1Desc: Assessment of scar depth, pore size and laxity grade.
microneedling.step2Desc: Makeup removal and disinfection with antiseptic solution.
microneedling.step3Desc: EMLA cream for 45–60 minutes for complete surface anaesthesia.
microneedling.step4Desc: Active cocktail or PRP centrifugation depending on modality.
microneedling.step5Desc: Roller or dermapen with 0.5–2.5 mm needles by zone and diagnosis.
microneedling.step6Desc: Infusion of chosen active through opened microchannels.
microneedling.step7Desc: Hyaluronic acid mask to seal and calm skin post-puncture.

bioestimulacion.heroP: It doesn't fill. It regenerates. High-concentration non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid to stimulate fibroblasts and restore dermal architecture from within.
bioestimulacion.conceptFiller: Filler (cross-linked HA): adds volume and corrects wrinkles. Structural effect.
bioestimulacion.conceptBio: Biostimulation (non-cross-linked HA): regenerates the dermis. Without adding volume.
bioestimulacion.step1Desc: Skin quality assessment and protocol definition.
bioestimulacion.step3Desc: Anaesthetic cream for 20 minutes for greater comfort.
bioestimulacion.step4Desc: Micropapule technique at 2–4 mm depth across the entire area.
bioestimulacion.step5Desc: Gentle massage to homogenise the product.
bioestimulacion.timeline3Desc: Optimal result. Firmer, more even skin.
bioestimulacion.indication3: Dermal quality loss without volume loss
bioestimulacion.indication5: Complement to fillers and botulinum toxin

mesoterapiaCapilar.heroP: Cocktail of capillary actives microinjected into the scalp to stop hair loss, strengthen the follicle and stimulate growth.
mesoterapiaCapilar.benefit1Desc: Reduces telogen effluvium and follicular miniaturisation.
mesoterapiaCapilar.benefit2Desc: Nutritive actives reinforce existing hair resistance.
mesoterapiaCapilar.benefit3Desc: Activates resting follicles to increase hair density.
mesoterapiaCapilar.benefit4Desc: Thicker, shinier hair with more body from the first sessions.
mesoterapiaCapilar.benefit5Desc: Actives work locally without hepatic metabolism or hormonal effects.
mesoterapiaCapilar.benefit6Desc: Enhances minoxidil, finasteride and other medical hair treatments.
mesoterapiaCapilar.benefit7Desc: Ideal as a preventive protocol before alopecia progresses.
mesoterapiaCapilar.benefit8Desc: Cocktail adapts to each patient's trichoscopic diagnosis.
mesoterapiaCapilar.activo1Desc: Enzymatic cofactor in keratin synthesis. Strengthens the hair shaft.
mesoterapiaCapilar.activo2Desc: Increases follicular blood flow and extends the anagen phase.
mesoterapiaCapilar.activo3Desc: Inhibits 5-alpha reductase and regulates DHT production.
mesoterapiaCapilar.activo4Desc: Improves scalp tone and local microcirculation.
mesoterapiaCapilar.activo5Desc: Cellular energy metabolism and structural protein synthesis.
mesoterapiaCapilar.activo6Desc: Maintains scalp hydration and follicular environment.
mesoterapiaCapilar.alopecia1Desc: Anti-DHT action + vasodilation. We stop follicular miniaturisation.
mesoterapiaCapilar.alopecia2Desc: Nutritive cocktail + biotin to recover density after diffuse loss.
mesoterapiaCapilar.alopecia3Desc: Adapted protocol for post-partum recovery without hormonal components.
mesoterapiaCapilar.step1Desc: Scalp evaluation with dermoscope to map zones.
mesoterapiaCapilar.step2Desc: Personalised formulation according to diagnosis and alopecia type.
mesoterapiaCapilar.step3Desc: Scalp cleansing and topical anaesthesia application.
mesoterapiaCapilar.step4Desc: Intradermal injections every 1 cm in diagnosed zones.
mesoterapiaCapilar.step6Desc: Do not wash for 24h. Avoid direct sun. Continue medical treatment.
mesoterapiaCapilar.step7Desc: Protocol of 6–8 sessions every 15 days for optimal result.
mesoterapiaCapilar.step8Desc: Trichoscopic control at 3 months and cocktail adjustment if needed.

radiofrecuenciaCorporal.heroP: Multipolar deep heat to reshape the silhouette, reduce cellulite and activate localised lipolysis without surgery.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.celulitis1Desc: Orange-peel skin visible only when pinched. Excellent protocol response.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.celulitis2Desc: Nodules visible at rest. Good response with 8–10 sessions.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.celulitis3Desc: Hard, painful nodules. Progressive improvement with intensive protocol.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.benefit1Desc: Acts on fat nodules and fibrous tissue in depth.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.benefit2Desc: Tissue tightening and visible improvement of body shape.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.benefit4Desc: Reduces the appearance of orange-peel skin on abdomen, thighs and buttocks.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.benefit6Desc: Protocol complemented with drainage to enhance elimination.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.benefit7Desc: Dermal collagen stimulation for smoother, firmer skin.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.benefit8Desc: Results improve session by session and are maintained with upkeep.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.step1Desc: Cellulite grade evaluation and priority zone definition.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.step2Desc: Measurements recorded for objective progress tracking.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.step3Desc: Specific oil to optimise glide and thermal conduction.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.step4Desc: Slow passes to gradually reach therapeutic temperature.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.step5Desc: Maintaining 43°C in target tissue for 20–30 minutes.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.step6Desc: Drainage massage to facilitate toxin and fluid elimination.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.step8Desc: Response recording and protocol adjustment for next session.
radiofrecuenciaCorporal.contra4: Infection or open wound in area

peelingQuimico.heroP: Controlled chemical exfoliation to renew skin from depth. Spots, texture, acne and ageing with a precision acid protocol.
peelingQuimico.acid1Desc: Deep exfoliation. Stimulates collagen and improves radiance. For aged and spotted skin.
peelingQuimico.acid2Desc: Lipolytic and keratolytic. Penetrates pores and regulates sebum. Ideal for acne-prone skin.
peelingQuimico.acid3Desc: Antimicrobial and gentle exfoliating action. For sensitive and dark skin with hyperpigmentation risk.
peelingQuimico.acid4Desc: Refractory scars, wrinkles and spots. Longer recovery time. Deeper result.
peelingQuimico.step1Desc: Fitzpatrick classification and evaluation of lesions to treat.
peelingQuimico.step2Desc: Removal of epidermal lipids to optimise acid penetration.
peelingQuimico.step3Desc: Controlled application with brush, evenly, from centre outward.
peelingQuimico.step4Desc: Observation of skin response: erythema, whitening or frosting.
peelingQuimico.step5Desc: Neutralisation with bicarbonate or water removal depending on acid.
peelingQuimico.timeline1Desc: Active peeling. Red and tight skin.
peelingQuimico.timeline2Desc: End of peeling. New skin visible.
peelingQuimico.timeline3Desc: Final result. Improved radiance, uniformity and texture.
peelingQuimico.contra4: Very sensitive skin or active rosacea

toxinaBotulinica.heroP: The most studied treatment in aesthetic medicine. Selective muscle relaxation to smooth expression wrinkles naturally and precisely.
toxinaBotulinica.approachFrozen: Frozen effect: total muscle block. Immobilised expression. Not our goal.
toxinaBotulinica.approachEstetia: Estetia technique: micro-conservative dosing. Softened wrinkles, preserved expression.
toxinaBotulinica.benefit1Desc: Conservative dosing to maintain facial expressiveness.
toxinaBotulinica.benefit2Desc: Return to your activity immediately after the session.
toxinaBotulinica.benefit3Desc: Applied early, prevents formation of static wrinkles.
toxinaBotulinica.benefit4Desc: Effect disappears in 3–6 months if you decide not to continue.
toxinaBotulinica.benefit5Desc: Injection points calculated for specific muscle anatomy.
toxinaBotulinica.benefit6Desc: Enhances results of fillers, skinboosters and biostimulators.
toxinaBotulinica.zone2Desc: Correction of frowning gesture. High-expressiveness zone.
toxinaBotulinica.zone3Desc: Smoothing of radiated wrinkles from the outer eye corner.
toxinaBotulinica.zone5Desc: Subtle elevation of upper lip and barcode correction.
toxinaBotulinica.zone6Desc: Nefertiti protocol for neck and jawline lifting.
toxinaBotulinica.step1Desc: Dynamic expression evaluation and mapping of muscles to treat.
toxinaBotulinica.step2Desc: Joint definition with patient of priority areas.
toxinaBotulinica.step3Desc: Injection strategy drawn on moving skin.
toxinaBotulinica.step4Desc: Chlorhexidine disinfection of all injection points.
toxinaBotulinica.step6Desc: Visual check of immediate result and correction if needed.
toxinaBotulinica.step7Desc: No exercise for 24h, do not lie down for 4h, do not massage the area.
toxinaBotulinica.milestone4Desc: Effect completely metabolised. New session if desired.
toxinaBotulinica.contra2: Myasthenia gravis or other neuromuscular diseases
toxinaBotulinica.contra3: Allergy to botulinum toxin or human albumin

hilosTensores.heroP: Non-surgical lifting with polydioxanone threads. Mechanical tissue repositioning and collagen stimulation for a natural, progressive lifting effect.
hilosTensores.dual1Desc: Immediate mechanical effect from thread traction.
hilosTensores.dual2Desc: Average duration of the combined effect.
hilosTensores.thread1Desc: No anchors. Pure collagen stimulation. For skin texture and quality.
hilosTensores.thread2Desc: With bidirectional micro-anchors. Mechanical lifting effect. For tissue repositioning.
hilosTensores.benefit1Desc: Visible mechanical repositioning from the same session.
hilosTensores.benefit2Desc: PDO activates neocollagenesis during its 6-month resorption.
hilosTensores.benefit3Desc: No scalpel or general anaesthesia. Performed in-office.
hilosTensores.benefit4Desc: Effect improves over the 2–3 months following the session.
hilosTensores.benefit5Desc: PDO is completely resorbed in 6 months. No permanent effect.
hilosTensores.benefit6Desc: Combines with botulinum toxin and fillers for complete lifting.
hilosTensores.step1Desc: Tissue ptosis evaluation and traction vector planning.
hilosTensores.step2Desc: Design of insertion points and thread direction.
hilosTensores.step3Desc: Lidocaine infiltration at entry points for complete anaesthesia.
hilosTensores.step4Desc: 18G needle loaded with thread for subcutaneous path.
hilosTensores.step5Desc: Doctor guides thread through subcutaneous plane to anchor point.
hilosTensores.step6Desc: Controlled thread traction to achieve desired lifting effect.
hilosTensores.step7Desc: Excess thread cut and entry point sealed.
hilosTensores.step8Desc: Symmetry check and tension adjustment if necessary.
hilosTensores.milestone1Desc: Visible lifting. Possible oedema and mild ecchymosis.
hilosTensores.milestone3Desc: Start of neocollagenesis. Skin quality improvement.
hilosTensores.milestone4Desc: Optimal combined result. Firmer, repositioned skin.

laserCapilar.heroP: Photobiomodulation to reactivate follicular metabolism and stop hair loss. Clinically validated LLLT technology.
laserCapilar.tech1Desc: Clinically validated wavelengths for capillary photobiomodulation.
laserCapilar.tech2Desc: Digital trichoscopy for objective diagnosis before treatment.
laserCapilar.tech3Desc: Certified devices with clinical evidence for androgenetic alopecia.
laserCapilar.benefit1Desc: Photonic energy stimulates follicle mitochondrial activity.
laserCapilar.benefit2Desc: Extends the active hair growth cycle.
laserCapilar.benefit4Desc: Enhances effect of PRP, mesotherapy and minoxidil.
laserCapilar.benefit5Desc: Validated by multiple clinical trials in androgenetic alopecia.
laserCapilar.benefit6Desc: Completely painless session. The patient feels nothing.
laserCapilar.benefit7Desc: Effects are enhanced session by session with the full protocol.
laserCapilar.benefit8Desc: Indicated for all patterns of androgenetic alopecia.
laserCapilar.benefit9Desc: One monthly session sustains the result indefinitely.
laserCapilar.step1Desc: Scalp mapping to identify miniaturised zones.
laserCapilar.step3Desc: Power and exposure time adjustment per diagnosis.
laserCapilar.step4Desc: LLLT device positioning on the scalp.
laserCapilar.step5Desc: 30 minutes exposure at 650/808 nm with therapeutic dose.
laserCapilar.step6Desc: Clinical history notation of response and session number.
laserCapilar.step8Desc: After full cycle, monthly session to sustain result.
laserCapilar.milestone4Desc: Optimal result of the full cycle.
laserCapilar.indication9: Combined with PRP or capillary mesotherapy
laserCapilar.indicationFootnote: * Results may vary depending on alopecia grade, age and individual treatment response.

iplFotorejuvenecimiento.heroP: Intense pulsed light to unify tone, eliminate spots and reduce redness. More radiant, even and youthful skin with precision phototherapy technology.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.benefit1Desc: Fragments superficial melanin to eliminate spots progressively.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.benefit2Desc: Light is absorbed by oxyhaemoglobin. Visible capillaries eliminated.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.benefit3Desc: Homogenising effect on overall skin tone.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.benefit4Desc: Dermal heat activates type I collagen synthesis.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.benefit5Desc: Visible improvement in radiance and overall skin appearance.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.benefit6Desc: No ablation. Skin regenerates from within.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.benefit7Desc: Mild erythema in first 24–48 hours. Normal routine next day.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.benefit8Desc: Specific protocol for each zone with adjusted parameters.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.indic4Desc: Accumulated sun damage and loss of radiance.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.step3Desc: Certified opaque glasses for patient and doctor.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.step4Desc: Test pulse on non-visible area to verify skin response.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.step5Desc: Systematic passes with contact gel and parameter control.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.step6Desc: Cold application to reduce immediate erythema.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.milestone1Desc: Spots darken (crust effect). Normal and expected.
iplFotorejuvenecimiento.milestone3Desc: Reduction of redness and visible capillaries.

laserCo2.heroP: The gold standard in skin rejuvenation. Precision fractional ablation for scars, deep wrinkles and complete epidermal renewal.
laserCo2.benefit1Desc: Up to 70% reduction in acne scars with the full cycle.
laserCo2.benefit2Desc: Elimination of damaged epidermis and complete regeneration.
laserCo2.benefit3Desc: Stimulation of collagen synthesis in mid and deep dermis.
laserCo2.benefit4Desc: Results on wrinkles other treatments cannot reach.
laserCo2.benefit5Desc: Regenerated tissue is new. Long-lasting result.
laserCo2.benefit6Desc: Fractionated at 30–70% depending on area and patient tolerance.
laserCo2.benefit7Desc: Fractional ablation technology with reproducible parameters.
laserCo2.benefit8Desc: Combines with IPL to address pigmentation and texture simultaneously.
laserCo2.benefit9Desc: Before/after recorded in clinical history with standardised photography.
laserCo2.indic1Desc: Atrophic scars: icepick, boxcar and rolling.
laserCo2.indic3Desc: Severe actinic damage and photoaged skin.
laserCo2.indic4Desc: Mature white and pearly stretch marks.
laserCo2.step1Desc: Scar classification (Goodman & Baron) and standardised photography.
laserCo2.step2Desc: 2 weeks of retinoids + SPF 50 to optimise results.
laserCo2.step3Desc: EMLA cream for 60 minutes for complete anaesthesia.
laserCo2.step4Desc: Density and energy configuration by area and diagnosis.
laserCo2.step5Desc: Systematic passes with simultaneous cooling system.
laserCo2.step6Desc: Cold application and soothing mask post-session.
laserCo2.step7Desc: Regenerating ointment, avoid sun for 30 days and daily SPF 50+.
laserCo2.step8Desc: Healing assessment and second session planning if appropriate.
laserCo2.milestone1Desc: Active peeling. Skin in renewal process.
laserCo2.indication5: Dull skin with severe actinic damage

cavitacion.heroP: Focused ultrasound to eliminate localised fat through acoustic cavitation. No surgery, no needles, no recovery time.
cavitacion.comboNotice: Combined protocol: cavitation + mandatory lymphatic drainage in the same session.
cavitacion.benefit1Desc: Ultrasound breaks adipocytes without affecting surrounding tissues.
cavitacion.benefit2Desc: Non-invasive session. Resume activity upon finishing.
cavitacion.benefit3Desc: Only slight warmth and ultrasound sound perceived.
cavitacion.benefit4Desc: Results improve session by session with full cycle.
cavitacion.benefit5Desc: Enhances effect with body radiofrequency and drainage.
cavitacion.benefit6Desc: Indicated for men and women with resistant localised fat.
cavitacion.benefit7Desc: Ultrasonic heat stimulates collagen and improves elasticity.
cavitacion.benefit8Desc: Effects are enhanced with each session of the cycle.
cavitacion.mech1Desc: Ultrasound creates microbubbles in adipose tissue.
cavitacion.mech2Desc: Bubbles implode generating pressure that destroys adipocytes.
cavitacion.mech3Desc: Released triglycerides are metabolised by the lymphatic system.
cavitacion.step1Desc: Zone evaluation, tissue pinching and BMI.
cavitacion.step2Desc: Measurements recorded for objective progress tracking.
cavitacion.step3Desc: Specific gel to optimise ultrasound transmission.
cavitacion.step4Desc: 20–30 minutes of focused ultrasound on the treatment area.
cavitacion.step5Desc: Immediate drainage massage post-cavitation to eliminate triglycerides.
cavitacion.step6Desc: Optional: post-cavitation radiofrequency to enhance lipolysis.
cavitacion.step7Desc: Treated area check and hydration guidelines.
cavitacion.step8Desc: Frequency definition: minimum 72h between sessions in the same zone.
cavitacion.contra4: Hernia or recent surgery in area
